connector.name: MyFitnessPal
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for MyFitnessPal: log, search, and analyze your food diary.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mfp-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mason-levyy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: MFP_COOKIE
env.description: MyFitnessPal session cookie (optional; 'mfp-mcp auth' is the guided alternative)

env.name: MFP_USERNAME
env.description: MyFitnessPal username; only needed if MFP's profile lookup fails for your account
